artworks.title: Stags in the Forest
artworks.description: There is a drawing of forest animals including deer, a monkey, a bear, and a hare. The animals are depicted in a forested setting, with deer in the background among trees. The deer have detailed antlers and fur textures. In the foreground, there is a bear and a monkey. The hare is shown in a resting position. The drawing showcases a stylized interpretation of a woodland scene with intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Bear Hunt
artworks.description: Drawing of a hunting scene with four dogs attacking a bear. A hunter holding a spear is nearby in a forested environment. The bear lies on its back, with its limbs raised defensively as the dogs bite and pin it to the ground. The artwork shows detailed fur and musculature on the animals. The background features a distant hilltop with a small castle or fort, surrounded by lush foliage. The style is reminiscent of German Renaissance artists like Albrecht Dürer, known for realistic depictions of wildlife and nature.

artworks.title: Gabriel Cortois de Pressigny
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man standing in a slightly turned position. He has short, graying hair and is dressed in formal ecclesiastical attire, including a cassock with embroidery, lace cuffs, and a cross. His hands are engaged with a book and a document, resting on a table. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a nude female figure seated on a chariot with one foot resting on a rotating sphere. Her head is turned towards the right side of the image. She has long flowing hair that is partially tied back, and her facial features are classically rendered with a serene expression. She is holding a long spear or stick in one hand. Above and to the right of the woman, a smaller, winged figure is depicted, drawing a bow. The background is finely detailed with line patterns radiating outward. The scene includes the word "FORTVNA" at the bottom and other text elements, including "VENVS" and "CUPID." A small balance scale is depicted floating near the female figure.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Fortress and Big Stairway
artworks.description: This image shows a grand castle on a rocky landscape. The view is from a slightly lower elevation, looking up at the structure. The horizon is not clearly visible as the castle and surrounding rocks dominate the scene. The drawing style features detailed line work depicting the architecture and foliage, with a monochromatic color palette of black ink. The castle is surrounded by dense trees and shrubs, with other structures visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Willow
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a town surrounded by a landscape. Trees frame the outskirts, while buildings, paths, and hills are visible in the distance. The town's church steeple and rooftops are below the horizon, with detailed linework and hatching techniques used for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and beige tones.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Castle in the Center
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated perspective, displaying a wide scene from close to far. The horizon is high, with clouds in the sky. A castle on a hill dominates the background. Detailed linework depicts trees, buildings, rocks, and a fallen tree in the foreground leading to a village in a valley. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: View on a River with a Castle on an Island
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, trees, a building resembling a castle on a hill, and a body of water. The scene is depicted in monochromatic tones with detailed lines showcasing texture and shadow. There are clusters of structures and trees in the distance.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with detailed trees in the foreground and a town in the distance. The etching creates a textured effect, depicting a path with figures and a horse leading towards the town.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with a Village
artworks.description: The image features a landscape view of a medieval village scene. It includes a stone bridge over a river, buildings, a church with a tower, trees, hills, mountains, and cloudy sky. The image is depicted in intricate detail using a monochromatic palette, focusing on contrasts of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Castle
artworks.description: The image is a detailed landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned above the center of the composition, featuring a grand castle on a rugged cliff in the distance. The castle is surrounded by dense foliage. The engraving shows intricate line work detailing landscape elements. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia and black creating contrast. Near the viewer, there are houses with tiled roofs and wooden structures among vegetation. A path or road leads from these structures towards the distant castle. The background includes hills and clouds sketched with fine lines.

artworks.title: Leonard von Eckh
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated with one arm resting on a ledge. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and is wearing a cap with ear flaps tied under the chin. He is wearing clothing with a fur collar and buttons down the front. His left hand is visible, resting on the ledge. The background includes ornate architectural details, a curtain to the left, a carved column to the right, and a scenic landscape visible through a window with trees, a bridge, and buildings in the distance. The lower part of the image features an inscribed plaque.

artworks.title: Felicitas von Eckh (-Freyberg)
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman seated with both arms resting on a surface in front of her. She is facing slightly left and wears a headscarf. She has a high neckline and intricate detailing on her clothing. Nearby, there are containers on a shelf and a drapery hanging on the right side. In the background, there is a framed section displaying an outdoor scene with buildings and greenery under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Lady von Eckh (born Piencsenau)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up. They are facing slightly to the right, with a neutral expression. Their features include a round face, prominent cheeks, and large, widely spaced eyes. Their hair is mostly covered by a hat with a netted texture. The person wears a garment with puffed sleeves, horizontal stripes, and a chain across the chest. They also wear an ornate necklace with three dangling elements. The background features a landscape view through a window on the left, with buildings and trees, a drapery on the right, and decorative architectural elements.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus (Mercury and Venus?)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing in a full-body view. The person on the left has curly hair with a leaf or floral ornament and draped fabric. The one on the right holds an infant, with loose waves or curls in their hair, draped in fabric. They interact with a hanging object, possibly a steaming pot or cauldron. Various items like rocks and tools lie on the grassy ground. The background has a textured surface, suggesting an outdoor setting with no distinct horizon visible.

artworks.title: The Man with the Torch and a Woman Followed by a Fool
artworks.description: The image shows three full-length figures standing close together in an alleyway. The central figure is a woman, standing straight with a high forehead, wearing a long gown with voluminous sleeves, a headdress, and a tasseled belt. To her right, a man in a tunic and hat gestures with one arm while holding a lit torch. To her left, another man holds a wooden club over his shoulder. In the background, a figure partially hides in a window in the brick wall. The scene is set in an outdoor area with detailed brickwork.

artworks.title: Solomon's Idolatry
artworks.description: The image displays several figures in a historical scene. In the center, a man is kneeling and gazing at a small statue holding a skull. Beside him, a woman stands in an ornate gown, holding a part of her dress. Surrounding them are men in robes and capes observing from behind a low wall. The background includes architectural elements, a pedestal with a sculpture, and a mountainous landscape under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in close-up. One figure is in profile sitting at a desk with hand poised as if writing in an open book. The person has wavy hair, a robe, and reaches the nape of the neck. The other figure is facing forward with curly hair, gazing at the viewer with a calm expression. This figure also has large wings. In the background is a blank wall.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright, holding a staff with both hands to the left. They have short, curly hair, a rugged expression, a furrowed brow, and distinct facial features. They wear a long robe, tied at the waist, and a cloak over their shoulders. The person's bare feet are visible below. A halo-like aura surrounds their head with radiating lines. The background is plain with subtle lines.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher Carrying the Infant Christ
artworks.description: The image shows an older man wading through water with a child on his shoulders. He holds a staff in one hand and wears a headscarf, tunic, cape, and a belt. The child has curly hair and is holding a cross-topped orb. In the background, there are mountains, hills, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: The image shows a middle-aged man standing barefoot. He is angled to the left and has a beard, slightly downturned eyes, and curly hair. He wears a long robe and holds a large saw in his left hand. There are radiating lines creating a halo-like circle behind his head.

artworks.title: Abigail and David
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armed figures and horses in a forested landscape. In the foreground, there are several figures equipped with weapons, including a soldier on horseback wearing armor and holding a lance. Beside him, another soldier stands, engaged in conversation, seemingly directing with a hand gesture. Additional figures and horses are visible, blending into the intricate detailing of the scene. The landscape features tall, thickly branched trees that dominate the composition, while the background reveals rocky formations and a distant view of a settlement or military camp.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.description: The image shows a group of full-body figures in various standing and kneeling postures. One central figure stands slightly off-center with long hair and a beard, wearing flowing robes and looking upward. A partially clothed man clings to him, while a woman in draped garments and a headdress stands nearby. Other figures surround them, some looking at the central figure. The subjects have defined features and elaborate hairstyles typical of the artwork's time period. They are not wearing any visible jewelry, but some hold objects like a cloth or a book. The background includes trees, stone structures, and mountainous or hilly terrains in the distance.
